_week: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (Week 46). Written from that week's numbers.
week_story: Orders fell 5.2% to 966 while units held almost flat (-1.1%).
The drop is Metatarsal Pads (53% of sales): down 15% to $9,467, led by the Small 6-pack (-45% to $904) and the Medium 6-pack (-15% to $4,537).
Metatarsal Bars (+30% to $1,241), the Posting Heel Wedge (+14% to $1,014) and smaller items (+20%) grew.
refunds: Refund money was $1,294 vs $1,215 last week. The Medium 6-pack is the largest at $319 (13 units), then the Large 6-pack ($123) and the single-pair Medium pad ($97, 11 units).
pacing_reco: November is $39,735 through Nov 15 ($2,649 a day), pacing to about $79.5K vs $88,044 in October. The same 15 days last year were $7,346.
ads_context: Ad spend fell 32% to $2,244 and ad sales fell 30% to $5,126, so ACoS eased to 43.8% (from 45.6%) and TACoS to 12.5% (from 17.1%).
Sponsored Display was cut to $156 (from $522) and Sponsored Products spend fell 44% to $945.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $3,081 on $956 (31.0% ACoS) and brought 146 orders.
Category keywords cost $771 for $1,169 in sales (66.0% ACoS); auto targeting ran at 48.4%.
bid_moves: Lower the bid on SB “metatarsal pads men” broad: $129 for $57 in sales.
Pause SP “metatarsal pad” broad (Neuroma campaign): $45, 38 clicks, no sales.
promotions: This week: 224 promotion orders and $403 in promotional discounts (vs 272 and $547 last week).
Discounting eased slightly ahead of Black Friday.
